purpose: Autonomously classify whether sampled short-video frames visibly prove product-presenting content so V1 can save a lightweight product lead record and continue browsing.
forbiddenOutputs: page assumptions outside the sampled frames

outputSchema.routeLabel: product_yes => read-comments-and-save-evidence (compatibility label; runtime writes product lead record and advances) | product_no => skip-current-video
outputSchema.nonExecutableSummary: short human-readable summary for product lead logging only; not an action instruction
outputSchema.confidence: number 0..1; never used to request human review for this binary route
outputSchema.visibleProductTypes: string[]; empty when decision=product_no unless a visible object is mentioned as insufficient evidence
outputSchema.evidenceObservations: string[] based only on sampled frames
outputSchema.reason: one precise sentence explaining YES/NO decision
outputSchema.aggregateReason: one sentence summarizing all sampled frames
outputSchema.uncertainty: string[] allowed only as explanation for product_no; never a third branch
